recipe.visualDefinition: A centered vertical portrait of a man covering his face with his hand, set within a large white square border. The image features high-contrast lighting, wet skin textures, and a stark, bold sans-serif title at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical image is nested within a square white canvas, creating a thick border.
The bold black typography at the top balances the visual weight of the barcode and advisory logo at the bottom.
The subject's green hair provides a singular point of saturated color against a neutral, warm-toned background.
coreInvariants: A wide, textured white border framing the central image.
Bold, italicized sans-serif typography positioned in the top margin.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium close-up portrait, centered horizontally, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's hand covering the face acts as the central focal point, drawing the eye to the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold title at the top, moves down to the central portrait, and finally rests on the technical metadata at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of white negative space in the outer border to isolate and emphasize the central image.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the typography and shadows of the photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted green in the subject's hair and warm skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high value contrast between the white border and the dark shadows of the photo.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for the main title, paired with utilitarian/functional metadata fonts at the bottom.
graphicDevices: Subtle paper texture on the white border

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and heavy oblique feel.
Provides a similar clean, modernist aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertical portrait of a man with short green hair, wet skin, and a bandage on his finger, covering his face in a tiled shower. Place this image inside a square white frame with a subtle paper texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, black, lowercase, italicized sans-serif title in the top center margin. Add a barcode and a small parental advisory logo in the bottom center margin.

verificationChecks: Is the title lowercase and italicized?
Is the central image a vertical rectangle inside a square border?
Is the lighting high-contrast and moody?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist's name or likeness.
Do not copy the exact barcode numbers.
Do not use the specific brand logos.
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white border has a subtle paper grain.
Check that the typography is perfectly centered.
Verify the image aspect ratio is vertical within a square canvas.
Confirm the skin appears wet with visible water droplets.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vertical intimate portrait with a wide white square border and bold, lowercase, italicized sans-serif typography for a minimalist editorial look.
